notes:
v4.6.113 — IBKR allocation now actually reaches your bots

🧩 Fixed the big one: when you set a bot's % in Tools → IBKR, it was saved locally but never pushed to the cloud — so a newly-added IBKR bot got no cash slice, showed $0, and quietly traded the whole account. Saving the IBKR table now syncs the allocations to the server, so cloud bots seed their sub-portfolio correctly. After updating: open Tools → IBKR, hit Save, then start the bot.

🪙 Crypto bots are Alpaca-only — IBKR has no reliable crypto data, so crypto can no longer be assigned to IBKR (the AI builder, the IBKR table, and the server all enforce it; any crypto bot stuck on IBKR is auto-retired).

💵 Alpaca crypto buys under $10 no longer fail — they're bumped to Alpaca's $10 minimum when cash allows, else skipped cleanly.

Update via the in-app banner.
